title: How Banks Are Preparing for AI Agents | Truist's Chief Privacy Officer | Recorded Live at AI4 2026
description_head:
How do you safely deploy AI agents inside one of America's largest banks?

In this episode of the Chief AI Officer Podcast, Sanjay Puri sits down with **Ron Whitworth**, Chief Privacy Officer at Truist Financial, to discuss how financial institutions are balancing AI innovation with privacy, compliance, cybersecurity, and trust.
